title: ServiceDown
summary: {{ $labels.job }} is down, or the server sends nothing

title: SlowRequests
summary: {{ $labels.service }}: 95% of requests take longer than 1 second

title: EventsBacklog
summary: The api cannot deliver events to {{ $labels.target }}. Nothing is lost: it is retried until it works.

title: EventsGivenUp
summary: Events for {{ $labels.target }} were given up on. Fix the cause, then run: node dist/events.js retry-failed (in the api container).

title: TelegramBacklog
summary: Telegram messages have been waiting more than 5 minutes

title: TelegramMessagesFailing
summary: Some Telegram messages were given up on (blocked users, bad chat id?)

title: ServerMemoryHigh
summary: The server uses more than 90% of its memory

title: NginxErrors
summary: Visitors are getting server errors from nginx (more than 5 in 5 minutes). A service may be unreachable from it.
